response.justification: Highly experienced fullstack engineer (15+ years, well beyond the 6+ requirement) with directly relevant recent work in TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, and AWS at Optilyz, plus current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure work (MCP code generators, agentic frameworks) that matches a specific and relatively rare requirement. Strong testing culture (TDD, built test runners and assertion libraries, taught Selenium/testing courses), Docker/Kubernetes exposure, polyglot background (Java, C/C++, Swift, D, PHP), and a CS degree. Main gaps are the absence of Nest.js, Kotlin, and explicit Jest/Vitest/Playwright experience, and frontend depth that leans more toward Ember than React — but these are learnable for someone with this engineering breadth. Worth interviewing to probe React/Nest depth and enterprise-scale product delivery.
strengths: Deep fullstack experience with TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, and AWS
Hands-on AI agent / MCP tooling work matching a niche requirement
Exceptional testing and craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, built test frameworks)
concerns: No Nest.js or Kotlin experience listed; Vitest/Jest/Playwright unstated
Frontend depth skews to Ember and legacy web rather than modern React
Significant effort spread across niche DLang and side projects vs. core stack

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js, Kotlin, and named testing frameworks
